summary: Wiki.js: a self-hosted wiki (NodeJS/Express + Objection.js ORM + GraphQL apollo-server) storing pages/pages history/page tree, tags, comments, assets, users/groups/permissions, auth strategies, storage/search/editor/renderer/analytics/logger provider configs, API keys and the whole site config as JSON in a settings table (PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQLite/MSSQL); content is also rendered and synced to pluggable storage targets and a search engine, with an Express REST layer for auth/upload and a GraphQL facade for nearly all data operations.

_no_edges.why: public signout; only calls provider.logout()/clears cookie/session, no DB write, no auth middleware, no preconditions (auth.js:129, users.js:870)
system-scheduled job (scheduler 'rebuild-tree'); truncates+reinserts pageTree with no further op call, no auth wall (jobs/rebuild-tree.js)
system-scheduled job (scheduler 'render-page'); writes pages.render/toc, calls renderer modules not app ops, no auth wall (jobs/render-page.js)
system-scheduled job (scheduler 'sync-storage'); calls storage backend sync + updates storage.state, no further app op, no auth wall (jobs/sync-storage.js)
scheduled job; deletes orphaned temp upload files only, no DB op, no auth wall (jobs/purge-uploads.js)
scheduled job; sanitizes an svg temp file on disk, no DB op, no auth wall (jobs/sanitize-svg.js)
internal helper called by Page.create/update; relates/unrelates PageTags but calls no other op, no auth wall (models/tags.js:63)
internal helper called by Page.create/move/delete; SQL REPLACE on pages.render, calls no other op, no auth wall (models/pages.js:850)
